description: Eawag publishes photographs of sensor displays from the floodX urban flooding experiments at Wangen, Switzerland. Cameras recorded display values more frequently than some data loggers could store measurements. The deposit groups images where display positions are consistent and supplies settings identifying those positions for automatic reading. Pressure-sensor images are split across archives that must be assembled before unpacking. Zenodo provides free public access under CC0-1.0. The landing page does not state exact sample frequencies or complete time coverage. A limitation is that camera movement and optical character recognition can introduce errors when reconstructing instrument series. These images can support independent checks of the extracted readings used in hydraulic model calibration. They complement the raw archive, which contains the corresponding optical-reading results and processing code, and the separate sensor-display videos. The review did not download images or run recognition software.
